item.title: A rare family of barn owls moved into Manhattan's Upper West Side. New Yorkers are captivated
item.description: Manhattan's Upper West Side has been reveling in the company of its latest celebrities: A family of barn owls nested in a water tower atop a building near Central Park.

item.title: Brewers sweep the Dodgers to reach the World Series for the first time since 1982
item.description: Propelled by a lockdown bullpen and repeated comebacks, the Brewers swept the two-time defending champion LA Dodgers out of the playoffs Thursday in Game 4 of the National League Championship Series.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: U.S. historic preservation law faces the most serious threat in its 60-year history
item.description: Congress and a federal agency are threatening to weaken the country's historic preservation law, fueling a backlash that critics say is as fiery as the one that led to the law's creation 60 years ago.

item.title: Inside the race between Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos for control of outer space
item.description: The Atlantic writer Josh Tyrangiel says Musk and Bezos each want to colonize the moon, mine its resources and launch thousands more satellites. He says their only real competition is each other.

item.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, after brief truce
item.description: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over.
